title: the tester's reseal-door proof measures only the tester: its trouble holder is a stand-in read through trouble's published store tool
intention: cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_reseal_door.py imports trouble's device module, cairn.devices.trouble.trouble, twice: tooth 9 stands a real TroubleDevice behind the door's raiser (:724) and _holder builds one for the three rung-1 teeth (:771). Trouble publishes only its store tool. What the tester owes: that its door signs the clear with the recipient's name and its own name as provenance, and that the cleared trouble reads gone through the published store tool.
why: Measured 2026-11-11: the build inspector's encapsulation_holds names cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_reseal_door.py:724 and :771 (cairn.devices.trouble.trouble). RULE 1: a ticket's proofs measure only that component.
traces_to: CLAUDE.md RULE 1; outline 2.3.7.1 (trouble publishes its store tool; readers read through it); outline 17.13.1.
how: test_reseal_door.py: _holder(root) becomes a stand-in raiser that writes the scratch store as the holder lays it out (a live trouble at <store>/<id>.json, a cleared one moved to the store tool's CLEARED_DIR, moved only by a clear signed by the recipient cc) and records every clear's signature. Tooth 9 uses it and asserts the clear is signed by cc, what_changed carries 'cairn test --reseal', and the store tool's live() reads empty. The three rung-1 teeth keep their assertions, read through live(root=store). New proof cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_tester_proofs_measure_only_tester.py carries the sieve and forbidden-module teeth.
